mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction starts and personal consumption expenditures signals strong underlying demand, which drives corporate earnings growth and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to produce positive 5d returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC between the joint signal and returns is below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates weakening supply-side capacity, which reduces corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in CPI inflation above 3.5% on a year-over-year basis signals persistent inflationary pressures, which increases the likelihood of further rate hikes and reduces equity risk appetite, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the mean return in high-CPI periods is not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real GDP growth and residential construction starts signals robust aggregate demand, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to generate positive 20d returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC between the interaction term and returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in non-farm payroll growth below 50k per month signals weakening labor market momentum, which reduces consumer spending and corporate hiring, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS < 50, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 100, combined with a rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5%, indicates a supply shock under monetary tightening, which increases input costs and reduces profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal produces positive 60d returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC between the joint signal and returns is below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.
